Bathroom Renovation Questions Common questions about bathroom renovations in Brisbane, answered by our network of specialists. How much does a bathroom renovation cost in Brisbane? Bathroom renovation costs in Brisbane typically range from $22,000-$26,000 for standard projects. Budget renovations start from $8,000-$15,000 for cosmetic updates, mid-range renovations cost $15,000-$35,000, and premium/luxury bathroom renovations can reach $35,000-$120,000+. Brisbane's humidity may add $500-$1,000 for extra waterproofing. Labour accounts for 40-50% of the total budget. How long does a bathroom renovation take? Bathroom renovation timelines vary by scope: cosmetic updates take 1-2 weeks, standard renovations take 3-6 weeks (HIA reports 13-25 days for installation), and full renovations with plumbing/electrical take 4-6 weeks.
